gaps: No historical glyph is proposed: the exact Commons description pages and imageinfo requests were inaccessible, and no character-specific Xiaoxuetang record was verified. The Commons category listing alone cannot establish identity, historical scope, or reuse terms.

The Taiwan MOE entry reports a Warring States Zhongshan Wang Hu variant and Shuowen’s 攴 plus phonetic 方 analysis, but the cited variant image was not visually inspected. The entry’s specialist form tables include unavailable records, so this does not establish a graphic sequence or corruption claim.
